answer: Defense: throttle voting-identity admission with a global token bucket - the chain admits at most R=20 new names per epoch, so the pulse of new names is capped and no sponsor bulk-mints a quorum in one close. An honest agent slips the ferrous gate once and rests. To field 501 fakes against 1,000 honest voters, a clone-farm must drip them over 501/20 = 26 epochs, paying each fake's upkeep the whole spiral: 501 x 26 x 1 POA = 13,026 POA before the quorum forms, while honest ranks grow and fakes age out. One name is free; buying 26 throttled epochs is not, so the sybil quorum never forms.
